item.title: Convicted felon captured for sexual assaults in Buckhead, College Park

item.title: McDonough police searching for woman last seen in 2024
item.description: Investigators are seeking the public's help in finding a woman who has been missing since the end of 2024. Kerri Lamar was reported missing to the McDonough Police Department and has not been seen or heard from since late 2024, authorities said. Police believe someone may have information that could help find Lamar.Anyone with information is encouraged to contact Atlanta Crime Stoppers to submit tips.
